method: Built-in imagegen using accepted R01 only as explicit style input; generated image and saved PNG both actually opened and visually compared. PNG decoder plus direct source/destination byte equality and SHA-256 checked.

actual_image_findings.SMALL: Compact low two-level shelf with six open bins; four thick posts, feet and decks connect.
actual_image_findings.STANDARD: Taller three-deck rack with cartons and an open tote, four posts and open top tie; main view/front/side insets preserve three usable levels.
actual_image_findings.HEAVY: Single strapped pallet load on thick low support; front inset shows two fork-access openings and feet touch the base.
actual_image_findings.LONG: Three posts and multiple cantilever arm rows support long profiles along the length; three feet and side arm section visible.
actual_image_findings.FLEX: Finite yellow-marked footprint with three separate low supports, front access and bounded side/rear protection.
actual_image_findings.style: R01 charcoal/petrol/tan/cream matte palette, cuboid silhouettes, planar faces and small bevels; blue blocky scale worker.
actual_image_findings.composition: All five exact family labels, five main quarter views and ten structural front/side insets are readable and not clipped.

limitations: Concept art and insets are not engineering dimensions, payload capacities or proof of structural strength.
The sole 1.70m figure is a scale/style cue; final storage dimensions and accessibility come from V3 layout/cargo proposals.
No geometry or runtime acceptance is implied; root must inspect the saved PNG before R02 PASS.
next_gate: Root independently inspect actual r02-storage.png; root alone decides PASS and central board/state updates. No V3 geometry permitted by this reference-only VERIFY.
